active_boundary: one batch_id shared by lineage_batch, lineage_program_state, lineage_edge, lineage_business_edge, and lineage_issue
invariants: A successful active snapshot has one shared batch_id across physical and business facts.
A fact is active only when its is_active flag and its joined lineage_batch.is_active flag are true.
A row_key is unique per physical row and may contain batch_id; a stable identity key is batch-independent.
TMP may occur in physical endpoints but never in a business endpoint.
A partial snapshot has no disappearance authority outside its declared scope.
An unverified business collapse failure fails closed and cannot replace the previous active snapshot.
A successful empty snapshot is still a published active batch with zero edge counts.

states.meaning: Rows are being inserted and validated inside the publish transaction; readers must not see them as current.
The five tables passed same-batch validation and the snapshot is the sole current projection.
Historical rows remain readable by explicit batch_id but do not participate in current queries.

cases.input: FULL complete snapshot with zero programs and zero edges
cases.active_result: new batch is active with physical_edge_count=0 and business_edge_count=0

cases.input: ProgramSource build and audit complete; physical DAG and business derivation complete
cases.physical_result: all direct physical edges, including TMP endpoints, are candidate rows
cases.business_result: safe formal source-to-target collapse rows are candidate rows
cases.issue_result: audit issues, if any, use the same batch_id
cases.active_result: physical and business rows switch active together

cases.input: Physical graph contains a classified orphan/cycle/self-reference or unresolved path with no safe business edge
cases.business_result: affected business edge is absent; no guessed TMP/formal endpoint is emitted
cases.issue_result: same-batch diagnostic explains the omitted edge
cases.active_result: only if the derivation returned a complete negative result; both layers still use the same batch

cases.input: Physical build succeeds but business collapse raises, times out, or cannot prove complete classification
cases.physical_result: may exist only inside rolled-back candidate transaction
cases.issue_result: failure may be emitted to external run observability; no half-active fact set
cases.active_result: previous successful snapshot remains complete and active

cases.input: Insert, validation, count check, stable-key check, or active switch fails
cases.issue_result: candidate issue rows rollback with the batch

cases.input: Two candidate program states share environment/source_profile/program_name
cases.issue_result: validation error, not a silently merged program

cases.input: Two rows in one batch share edge_key
cases.physical_result: candidate rejected; repeated statement evidence must be aggregated into one row

cases.input: Two rows in one batch share business_edge_key after multi-path collapse
cases.business_result: candidate rejected; paths must be deduplicated into one derived row
cases.issue_result: validation error or diagnostic before switch

cases.input: PARTIAL replay scopes profile_A and does not read profile_B
cases.physical_result: profile_A is rebuilt/rebased; profile_B physical facts are copied to the new candidate
cases.business_result: profile_A is rebuilt/rebased; profile_B business facts are copied to the new candidate
cases.issue_result: issues outside profile_A are not deleted
cases.active_result: one new active batch contains both profiles without merging their program keys
cases.deletion_authority: profile_A only if explicitly complete; never profile_B

cases.input: Historical batch N-1 and current active batch N both contain a similar endpoint
cases.physical_result: current physical query joins active lineage_batch and filters active flag
cases.business_result: current business query joins the same active lineage_batch and filters active flag
cases.issue_result: historical issues are excluded from current projection

cases.input: Partial or limited replay omits a previously active program
cases.physical_result: omitted program physical facts are rebased unless inside an explicitly complete scope
cases.business_result: omitted program business facts are rebased unless inside an explicitly complete scope
cases.issue_result: omitted program issues are rebased outside complete scope
cases.active_result: absence is not interpreted as deletion outside scope

cases.input: FULL complete scan of environment/profile scope omits a previously active program
cases.physical_result: program physical facts are absent from the new active candidate in that scope
cases.business_result: program business facts are absent from the new active candidate in that scope
cases.issue_result: old issue rows remain historical; current issue projection follows candidate
cases.active_result: scoped disappearance is effective; historical batch remains readable

cases.input: source_hash is non-empty and equal to active state; pipeline_version is equal
cases.physical_result: physical facts are rebased to the new batch without rebuilding
cases.business_result: business facts are rebased from the same old physical derivation
cases.issue_result: state and issues are rebased according to lifecycle rules
cases.active_result: stable keys stay equal; row_keys change because batch_id changes

cases.input: Same ProgramIdentity but source_hash changes or is unavailable
cases.business_result: business derivation rebuild is required; no one-layer reuse
cases.issue_result: new diagnostics are reconciled in the same candidate
cases.active_result: program_key and business_edge_key may remain stable while derived hashes/lifecycle timestamps change

cases.physical_result: physical facts rebuild because parser/DAG/audit semantics may change
cases.business_result: business facts rebuild from the new physical candidate
cases.issue_result: policy/rule evidence is regenerated without freezing #36 values
cases.active_result: no reuse based on hash alone

cases.input: TMP node name changes while formal business source and target stay equal
cases.physical_result: physical edge_key changes because physical endpoints changed
cases.business_result: business_edge_key stays equal; physical_derivation_hash changes if topology labels are included
cases.issue_result: no basename-only merge; diagnostics remain physical if affected
cases.active_result: business identity is stable; proposed last_changed_at changes for derived topology change

cases.input: Physical route changes but business source/target remain equal
cases.physical_result: new direct physical facts are materialized
cases.business_result: one same business_edge_key is rebuilt; depth/path_count/derivation hash are compared
cases.issue_result: unsafe or incomplete path classification is diagnostic and may fail closed
cases.active_result: business identity remains stable; last_changed_at follows final derived-change decision

cases.input: A previously disappeared ProgramIdentity appears again in a later complete scope
cases.physical_result: new observation is rebuilt; old physical rows remain historical
cases.business_result: new candidate rows use the current batch and safe current derivation
cases.issue_result: old issue history is not silently mutated
cases.active_result: restore is not rename inference; first_seen follows #38 restore semantics
